notes: WebsiteBuyer is the only factory-deployed application contract. Its single constructor argument is the launch owner (Ownable2Step), filled by $owner; the constructor calls no other contract and requires no code at any address, so it deploys on an empty chain. Everything else is a hardcoded constant in source: IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7, PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90, the native ETH/IMD v4 pool (currency0 = 0, currency1 = IMD, fee 10000, tickSpacing 200, no hooks, id 0xb07d640fd9e2eb9dc81b953c8e4fd006bdfeaf276010fb5418eb763ca15abfb3), the initial IdentityMD Intake v2 0xa43e6f75ee006411f79ac1c84120606c2330de82 and the job.open action. buyWebsite(string words) is payable: it validates the words (non-empty, at most 1000 bytes, no double quote, backslash or control character), reads the live price with priceOf, swaps all sent ETH for IMD on the pool, reverts if the swap returned less than the price, pays exactly the price for a job.open through the buyer's own IntakeAccount, and returns all surplus IMD to the buyer in the same call. IntakeAccount is not a launch contract: WebsiteBuyer creates one per buyer with CREATE2 on that buyer's first purchase, with WebsiteBuyer as hub and the buyer as user, so the project stays the buyer's and only they can continue it through execute. The owner can change the Intake with setIntake (must have code) and pause or resume purchases with setPaused. Result callbacks (onIntakeResult) store and emit the result hash and URI; failure callbacks (onIntakeFailure) record refusals and failures. No token, pool, funding or initialization call is part of this launch.
